answer_1.quote: producing a human-understandable description text s_f of the feature f
answer_1.outputs: Feature descriptions generated by explainer models like GPT-4o mini

answer_2.quote: The description s_f is considered faithful if the mean activation for the activating examples exceeds that of the neutral examples, namely: m_activating > m_neutral ... The description s_f is faithful if the LLM selects T_f

answer_3.quote: feed s_f concatenated with T_f, T_f' and T_f'' to a judge LLM ... and task it to indicate which of the three sets matches s_f
methods: pairwise selection among three sets based on description match

answer_4.quote: we conducted two human evaluations ... tasked human annotators (6 graduate students) with scoring their faithfulness with respect to (a) input-faithfulness: what activates the feature and (b) output-faithfulness: how the feature affects the model's outputs
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored faithfulness based on input-activation alignment and output-effect alignment
